caption: The video captures a layered mountain silhouette against a warm golden-orange sky, its brightest glow concentrated in the upper-left and fading to deeper amber toward the right. Several overlapping ridge lines—a pale distant ridge, a darker middle ridge with a pointed peak near the center, and a near-black foreground slope—are backlit above a flat dark band along the bottom edge. Over time the sky's luminance rises: the near-white glow in the upper-left broadens and the overall amber tone lightens. Meanwhile a faint reddish-orange glow becomes more apparent at the left edge in later moments. The mountain silhouettes retain their shapes while the ridgelines shift slowly to the right across the view, without visibly deforming or changing their overlapping arrangement. The dark foreground band remains a flat strip along the bottom.
